Join Us Tonight!! #vahomeloan 

Tonight is the night!!!!
Are you a Veteran or active-duty service member thinking about buying a home?
Join us for a FREE VA Home Loan Seminar on May 22nd at Mr. Gatti’s Pizza in Killeen from 6:30–8:30 p.m. 🍕
✅ Learn how to buy a home with zero down
✅ Get expert tips on using your VA loan benefits
✅ Discover how to avoid common mistakes
✅ Ask your questions LIVE with Danny Reyna, U.S. Air Force Veteran & VA loan expert
🍕 Plus: Free food and drinks for all who RSVP!
Whether you're PCSing to Fort Cavazos or exploring your first home purchase, this event is packed with value and real-world advice for military families and Veterans.
📲 Spots are limited! Comment "Going" below to RSVP!!
#VAHomeLoanSeminar #KilleenRealEstate #FortCavazos #MilitaryHomeBuying #VALoanTexas #VeteranHomebuyer #PCS2025 #i35Group #KilleenEvents #freefood #freepizza #killeentx #realestate #realestateagent #realtorlife #mayevent #centraltexas #centraltexasrealestate
